note: Accepted name: POWO urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:263419-1 Pinus yunnanensis Franch., 'This species is accepted'; WFO wfo-0000481591 Pinus yunnanensis, Accepted. Not on main (grep by species and DOI; the species only appears on a wanted line for another paper). Licence: CC BY, copyright line read on the PDF; Crossref lists CC BY 4.0. Tested range is 5% to 100% of full sunlight. The decline is not significant at every level. Results 3.7: root NSC of 1-year-old seedlings was 30.14%, 40.62% and 50.54% lower than CK in L1, L2 and L4, and L3 is not among the lower treatments (root soluble sugar peaked there at 31.93 mg/g, and Discussion 4.2 says root soluble sugar and starch did not differ between L3 and the control); root NSC of 3-year-old seedlings was 47.14%, 34.55% and 45.65% lower than CK in L2, L3 and L4, with no L1 difference. The authors read the fall as NSC consumed and moved to other organs, with a risk of carbon depletion under deep shade; photosynthesis was not measured and no photoreceptor is invoked, so this is a response to light quantity that may reflect carbon supply rather than light signalling.
